text: Design and implement Model Context Protocol servers and tooling. Shape the future of AI agent infrastructure.

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the universal bridge between foundation models and external tools, databases, and environments. You will architect Hanzo's MCP ecosystem: high-throughput transport protocols, sandboxed runtime servers, schema validation, and multi-agent coordination layers.

Hanzo builds an open AI cloud — compilers, models, distributed infrastructure, and agent tooling. Our codebases are predominantly open source, and team members operate with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership.
Architect and maintain high-performance MCP servers connecting models to codebases, cloud infra, and enterprise data.
Implement secure Hanzo Visor, WebAssembly, and container sandboxes for untrusted agent tool execution.
Design protocol extensions for streaming responses, binary payloads, and distributed MCP federations.
Build developer SDKs in TypeScript, Python, and Go for authoring and hosting MCP servers.
Experience with protocol design, RPCs (gRPC, JSON-RPC, SSE, WebSockets), and type-safe schema validation (JSON Schema, Protobuf).
Proficiency in TypeScript, Go, or Rust.
Experience with secure sandbox execution environments (Docker, Firecracker, Hanzo Visor, Wasm).
Passion for developer experience, clean documentation, and robust error handling.
Active involvement in the MCP open source ecosystem or agent frameworks.
Background in identity, authentication, and capability-based authorization.
Distributed globally. We value outcomes over hours spent at a desk.
Ship work that developers worldwide inspect, clone, and build on.
Direct access to leadership and the autonomy to build whole systems.
